title: Do Sal à Beterraba
subtitle: Em dois anos o campo trocou o sal pelo alimento, o placebo e a régua.
content:
[[COMP:PioneersSim]]

Fontes

  • Larsen FJ, Weitzberg E, Lundberg JO, Ekblom B. Effects of dietary nitrate on oxygen cost during exercise. Acta Physiol (Oxf) 2007;191(1):59-66. — NaNO₃ 0,1 mmol/kg/dia por 3 dias, VO₂ 2,98 → 2,82 L/min (−5,4%), eficiência 19,7 → 21,1%.
  • Bailey SJ, Winyard P, Vanhatalo A, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation reduces the O2 cost of low-intensity exercise and enhances tolerance to high-intensity exercise in humans. J Appl Physiol 2009;107(4):1144-1155. — suco 500 mL/dia (5,6 mmol), 6 dias, TTE 583 → 675 s (+16%), placebo de groselha-preta.
  • Lansley KE, Winyard PG, Fulford J, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation reduces the O2 cost of walking and running: a placebo-controlled study. J Appl Physiol 2011;110(3):591-600. — placebo depletado de nitrato (~0,003 mmol), TTE +15%, depletado = sem bebida.
  • Lansley KE, Winyard PG, Bailey SJ, et al. Acute dietary nitrate supplementation improves cycling time trial performance. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2011;43(6):1125-1131. — contrarrelógio de 4 km (−2,8%) e 16,1 km (−2,7%) em 9 ciclistas competitivos.

title: +16% ou 1%?
subtitle: O mesmo efeito, medido por duas réguas: o tempo até a exaustão infla o número e o ruído.
content:
[[COMP:TteTtSim]]

Fontes

  • Jones AM. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance. Sports Med 2014;44(Suppl 1):S35-S45. — ~15% de TTE ≈ 1% de contrarrelógio (citando Hopkins 1999).
  • Hinckson EA, Hopkins WG. Reliability of time to exhaustion analyzed with critical-power and log-log modeling. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2005;37(4):696-701. — conversão TTE → contrarrelógio, ~1:10, varia ~28% entre corredores.
  • Jeukendrup A, Saris WH, Brouns F, Kester AD. A new validated endurance performance test. Med Sci Sports Exerc 1996;28(2):266-270. — CV 26,6% (TTE a 75% Wmax) × 3,35% (contrarrelógio de trabalho fixo).
  • Laursen PB, Francis GT, Abbiss CR, Newton MJ, Nosaka K. Reliability of time-to-exhaustion versus time-trial running tests in runners. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2007;39(8):1374-1379. — CV 15,1% × 2,0% (5 km) e 13,2% × 3,3% (1.500 m).
  • Amann M, Hopkins WG, Marcora SM. Similar sensitivity of time to exhaustion and time-trial time to changes in endurance. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2008;40(3):574-578. — TTE −45% × TT +5,7% na hipóxia; sensibilidade semelhante.
  • Bailey SJ, Winyard P, Vanhatalo A, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation reduces the O2 cost of low-intensity exercise and enhances tolerance to high-intensity exercise in humans. J Appl Physiol 2009;107(4):1144-1155. — origem do +16%.

title: Dose: Mais não é Melhor
subtitle: 4,2 mmol não faz nada; 8,4 mmol funciona; 16,8 mmol não acrescenta.
content:
[[COMP:DoseResponseSim]]

Fontes

  • Wylie LJ, Kelly J, Bailey SJ, et al. Beetroot juice and exercise: pharmacodynamic and dose-response relationships. J Appl Physiol 2013;115(3):325-336. — 4,2/8,4/16,8 mmol: tolerância +14% e +12%, custo de O₂ −1,7% e −3,0%.
  • Shannon OM, Allen JD, Bescos R, et al. Dietary inorganic nitrate as an ergogenic aid: an expert consensus derived via the modified Delphi technique. Sports Med 2022;52(10):2537-2558. — 8–16 mmol agudo ou 4–16 mmol/dia crônico, última dose 2–4 h antes.
  • Maughan RJ, Burke LM, Dvorak J, et al. IOC consensus statement: dietary supplements and the high-performance athlete. Br J Sports Med 2018;52(7):439-455. — 5–9 mmol (310–560 mg) 2–3 h antes; 16,8 não supera 8,4 mmol.
  • Senefeld JW, Wiggins CC, Regimbal RJ, et al. Ergogenic effect of nitrate supplementation: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2020;52(10):2250-2261. — sem efeito com 1,6–5,0 mmol/dia; efeito semelhante entre 5,1 e 28,7 mmol/dia.

title: Agudo ou Crônico?
subtitle: O nitrito pica em 2–3 h: tomar na hora da prova é tarde demais.
content:
[[COMP:TimingSim]]

Fontes

  • Senefeld JW, Wiggins CC, Regimbal RJ, et al. Ergogenic effect of nitrate supplementation: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2020;52(10):2250-2261. — melhor janela 2–3,5 h; dias de uso (1–15) sem diferença.
  • Wylie LJ, Kelly J, Bailey SJ, et al. Beetroot juice and exercise: pharmacodynamic and dose-response relationships. J Appl Physiol 2013;115(3):325-336. — pico de nitrito em ~2–3 h.
  • Kadach S, Piknova B, Black MI, et al. Time course of human skeletal muscle nitrate and nitrite concentration changes following dietary nitrate ingestion. Nitric Oxide 2022;121:1-10. — nitrato muscular com pico em 3 h (181 nmol/g) e basal a partir de 9 h.
  • Jones AM. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance. Sports Med 2014;44(Suppl 1):S35-S45. — nitrato plasmático em 1–2 h, nitrito em 2–3 h, retorno ao basal em ~24 h.
  • Shannon OM, Allen JD, Bescos R, et al. Dietary inorganic nitrate as an ergogenic aid: an expert consensus derived via the modified Delphi technique. Sports Med 2022;52(10):2537-2558. — última dose 2–4 h antes.
  • Wong TH, Sim A, Burns SF. The effects of nitrate ingestion on high-intensity endurance time-trial performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Exerc Sci Fit 2022;20(4):305-316. — contrarrelógio de 5–30 min: agudo g 0,10, crônico g 0,30.
  • Poon ET, Iu JC, Sum WM, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance: an umbrella review of 20 published systematic reviews with meta-analyses. Sports Med 2025;55(5):1213-1231. — TTE maior com ≥6 mmol/dia e uso crônico (>3 dias).
  • Vanhatalo A, Bailey SJ, Blackwell JR, et al. Acute and chronic effects of dietary nitrate supplementation on blood pressure and the physiological responses to moderate-intensity and incremental exercise. Am J Physiol Regul Integr Comp Physiol 2010;299(4):R1121-R1131. — 2,5 h, 5 e 15 dias: VO₂ e PA menores nos três; potência de pico só aos 15 dias.
  • Hogwood AC, Anderson KC, Ortiz de Zevallos J, et al. Limited effects of inorganic nitrate supplementation on exercise training responses: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Sports Med Open 2023;9(1):84. — nitrato + treino ≥3 semanas: VO₂pico SMD 0,18 n.s.; TTE SMD 0,08 n.s.

title: O Que Dizem as Meta-análises
subtitle: Grande no tempo até a exaustão, pequeno ou nulo no contrarrelógio: depende do desfecho e de quem entra.
content:
[[COMP:EnduranceForestSim]]

Fontes

  • Senefeld JW, Wiggins CC, Regimbal RJ, et al. Ergogenic effect of nitrate supplementation: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2020;52(10):2250-2261. — 80 estudos: d 0,174 geral; TTE 0,324; TT 0,086; 1.179 homens e 156 mulheres.
  • Poon ET, Iu JC, Sum WM, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance: an umbrella review of 20 published systematic reviews with meta-analyses. Sports Med 2025;55(5):1213-1231. — umbrella de 20 revisões, 180 estudos, 2.672 pessoas: TTE SMD 0,33; TT sem melhora significativa; AMSTAR-2 baixo.
  • Gao C, Gupta S, Adli T, et al. The effects of dietary nitrate supplementation on endurance exercise performance and cardiorespiratory measures in healthy adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2021;18(1):55. — TT −1,98 s (−4,37 a 0,41), TTE +25,3 s; certeza GRADE baixa.
  • Campos HO, Drummond LR, Rodrigues QT, et al. Nitrate supplementation improves physical performance specifically in non-athletes during prolonged open-ended tests: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Br J Nutr 2018;119(6):636-657. — não atletas 0,25; atletas 0,04.

title: O Teto do Treinado
subtitle: O efeito cai de forma contínua com o VO₂max e, na média, some perto de 65.
content:
[[COMP:TrainedCeilingSim]]

Fontes

  • Senefeld JW, Wiggins CC, Regimbal RJ, et al. Ergogenic effect of nitrate supplementation: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2020;52(10):2250-2261. — VO₂pico ≥65: d 0,02 (−0,10 a 0,14); porcentagens por faixa de Porcelli, resumidas por Senefeld (dado secundário).
  • Shannon OM, Allen JD, Bescos R, et al. Dietary inorganic nitrate as an ergogenic aid: an expert consensus derived via the modified Delphi technique. Sports Med 2022;52(10):2537-2558. — efeito diminuído acima de VO₂pico 60.
  • Porcelli S, Ramaglia M, Bellistri G, et al. Aerobic fitness affects the exercise performance responses to nitrate supplementation. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2015;47(8):1643-1651. — quanto mais apto, menor a subida de nitrato (r 0,86) e nitrito (r 0,75) com 5,5 mmol.
  • Jones AM. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance. Sports Med 2014;44(Suppl 1):S35-S45. — as quatro explicações para o teto.
  • McConell GK, Bradley SJ, Stephens TJ, et al. Skeletal muscle nNOS mu protein content is increased by exercise training in humans. Am J Physiol Regul Integr Comp Physiol 2007;293(2):R821-R828. — nNOSμ ~60% maior em atletas de endurance.
  • Poveda JJ, Riestra A, Salas E, et al. Contribution of nitric oxide to exercise-induced changes in healthy volunteers: effects of acute exercise and long-term physical training. Eur J Clin Invest 1997;27(11):967-971. — nitrito basal ~2,5× maior em atletas.
  • Tesch PA, Karlsson J. Muscle fiber types and size in trained and untrained muscles of elite athletes. J Appl Physiol 1985;59(6):1716-1720. — % de fibra lenta no vasto lateral dos corredores.
  • Lansley KE, Winyard PG, Bailey SJ, et al. Acute dietary nitrate supplementation improves cycling time trial performance. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2011;43(6):1125-1131. — ensaio em ciclistas de clube (VO₂max ~56).
  • Cermak NM, Gibala MJ, van Loon LJ. Nitrate supplementation's improvement of 10-km time-trial performance in trained cyclists. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2012;22(1):64-71. — TT de 10 km −1,2% (VO₂pico 58).
  • Cermak NM, Res P, Stinkens R, et al. No improvement in endurance performance after a single dose of beetroot juice. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2012;22(6):470-478. — TT de ~1 h sem diferença (VO₂pico 60).
  • Bescós R, Rodríguez FA, Iglesias X, et al. Acute administration of inorganic nitrate reduces VO2peak in endurance athletes. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2011;43(10):1979-1986. — VO₂pico 65; sem diferença no tempo do incremental.
  • Bescós R, Ferrer-Roca V, Galilea PA, et al. Sodium nitrate supplementation does not enhance performance of endurance athletes. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2012;44(12):2400-2409. — prova de 40 min sem diferença.
  • Peacock O, Tjønna AE, James P, et al. Dietary nitrate does not enhance running performance in elite cross-country skiers. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2012;44(11):2213-2219. — VO₂max ~70, 5 km sem diferença.
  • Christensen PM, Nyberg M, Bangsbo J. Influence of nitrate supplementation on VO2 kinetics and endurance of elite cyclists. Scand J Med Sci Sports 2013;23(1):e21-e31. — VO₂max 72, TT sem diferença.
  • Boorsma RK, Whitfield J, Spriet LL. Beetroot juice supplementation does not improve performance of elite 1500-m runners. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2014;46(12):2326-2334. — VO₂pico 80, 1.500 m sem diferença.

title: A Floresta de Nulos
subtitle: Estudos em atletas de elite cruzam o zero, mas a maioria não tinha poder para ~1%.
content:
[[COMP:EliteNullSim]]

Fontes

  • Peacock O, Tjønna AE, James P, et al. Dietary nitrate does not enhance running performance in elite cross-country skiers. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2012;44(11):2213-2219. — 10 esquiadores, 5 km 1005 × 996 s (p 0,12).
  • Christensen PM, Nyberg M, Bangsbo J. Influence of nitrate supplementation on VO2 kinetics and endurance of elite cyclists. Scand J Med Sci Sports 2013;23(1):e21-e31. — 10 ciclistas, VO₂ 72, 18:20 × 18:37.
  • Boorsma RK, Whitfield J, Spriet LL. Beetroot juice supplementation does not improve performance of elite 1500-m runners. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2014;46(12):2326-2334. — 8 corredores de 1.500 m, VO₂ 80, 19,5 mmol por 8 dias; dois ganhos de 5,8 e 5,0 s (agudo).
  • Wilkerson DP, Hayward GM, Bailey SJ, et al. Influence of acute dietary nitrate supplementation on 50 mile time trial performance in well-trained cyclists. Eur J Appl Physiol 2012;112(12):4127-4134. — 8 ciclistas, 50 milhas 136,7 × 137,9 min.
  • Bescós R, Ferrer-Roca V, Galilea PA, et al. Sodium nitrate supplementation does not enhance performance of endurance athletes. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2012;44(12):2400-2409. — 13 atletas, 26,4 × 26,3 km (p 0,61).
  • Lane SC, Hawley JA, Desbrow B, et al. Single and combined effects of beetroot juice and caffeine supplementation on cycling time trial performance. Appl Physiol Nutr Metab 2014;39(9):1050-1057. — 24 ciclistas, beterraba sozinha −0,4% (p 0,6).
  • Cermak NM, Res P, Stinkens R, et al. No improvement in endurance performance after a single dose of beetroot juice. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2012;22(6):470-478. — 20 ciclistas, potência 275 × 278 W.
  • Hopkins WG, Hawley JA, Burke LM. Design and analysis of research on sport performance enhancement. Med Sci Sports Exerc 1999;31(3):472-485. — cruzado com a prova como desfecho precisa de 16–65 atletas.
  • Laursen PB, Francis GT, Abbiss CR, Newton MJ, Nosaka K. Reliability of time-to-exhaustion versus time-trial running tests in runners. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2007;39(8):1374-1379. — CV do contrarrelógio de 1.500 m (3,3%) e de 5 km (2,0%) usado no cálculo da faixa.
  • Maughan RJ, Burke LM, Dvorak J, et al. IOC consensus statement: dietary supplements and the high-performance athlete. Br J Sports Med 2018;52(7):439-455. — ganho esperado de 1–3% em provas < 40 min.
  • Atkinson G, Batterham AM. True and false interindividual differences in the physiological response to an intervention. Exp Physiol 2015;100(6):577-588. — por que diferença individual observada ainda não é resposta.

title: Na Altitude
subtitle: Plausibilidade forte, evidência mista: a hipóxia não liberta o efeito em quem é muito treinado.
content:
[[COMP:AltitudeSim]]

Fontes

  • Vanhatalo A, Fulford J, Bailey SJ, et al. Dietary nitrate reduces muscle metabolic perturbation and improves exercise tolerance in hypoxia. J Physiol 2011;589(Pt 22):5517-5528. — hipóxia 14,5% de O₂: tolerância 393 → 477 s, igual à normóxia (471 s).
  • Shannon OM, Duckworth L, Barlow MJ, et al. Dietary nitrate supplementation enhances high-intensity running performance in moderate normobaric hypoxia, independent of aerobic fitness. Nitric Oxide 2016;59:63-70. — 12 corredores, VO₂max 47–77, 1.500 m −3,2%, todos melhoraram.
  • Shannon OM, Duckworth L, Barlow MJ, et al. Effects of dietary nitrate supplementation on physiological responses, cognitive function, and exercise performance at moderate and very-high simulated altitude. Front Physiol 2017;8:401. — TT de 3 km −3,8% (3.000 m) e −4,2% (4.300 m).
  • Muggeridge DJ, Howe CC, Spendiff O, et al. A single dose of beetroot juice enhances cycling performance in simulated altitude. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2014;46(1):143-150. — TT de 16,1 km −2,2% em ~2.500 m simulados.
  • Masschelein E, Van Thienen R, Wang X, et al. Dietary nitrate improves muscle but not cerebral oxygenation status during exercise in hypoxia. J Appl Physiol 2012;113(5):736-745. — TTE −36% na hipóxia e +5% com beterraba.
  • Arnold JT, Oliver SJ, Lewis-Jones TM, et al. Beetroot juice does not enhance altitude running performance in well-trained athletes. Appl Physiol Nutr Metab 2015;40(6):590-595. — VO₂max 66, 10 km: 2862 × 2874 s; melhora de 11 s, IC −60 a 38 s.
  • MacLeod KE, Nugent SF, Barr SI, et al. Acute beetroot juice supplementation does not improve cycling performance in normoxia or moderate hypoxia. Int J Sport Nutr Exerc Metab 2015;25(4):359-366. — ciclistas VO₂pico ≥60: nulo em normóxia e hipóxia.
  • Bourdillon N, Fan JL, Uva B, et al. Effect of oral nitrate supplementation on pulmonary hemodynamics during exercise and time trial performance in normoxia and hypoxia: a randomized controlled trial. Front Physiol 2015;6:288. — TT de 15 km nulo em normóxia e 11% de O₂.
  • Nybäck L, Glännerud C, Larsson G, et al. Physiological and performance effects of nitrate supplementation during roller-skiing in normoxia and normobaric hypoxia. Nitric Oxide 2017;70:1-8. — TT de 1.000 m nulo em normóxia e 16,8% de O₂.
  • Kang C, Lin N, Xiong Y, et al. Effects of nitrate supplements on cardiopulmonary fitness at high altitude: a meta-analysis of nine randomized controlled trials. PLoS One 2025;20(4):e0319667. — meta-análise de 9 ECRs: SpO₂ SMD −0,08, VO₂max SMD −0,17.
  • Shannon OM, McGawley K, Nybäck L, et al. "Beet-ing" the mountain: a review of the physiological and performance effects of dietary nitrate supplementation at simulated and terrestrial altitude. Sports Med 2017;47(11):2155-2169. — altitude terrestre: poucos estudos e sem efeito em VO₂ ou SpO₂.
  • Senefeld JW, Wiggins CC, Regimbal RJ, et al. Ergogenic effect of nitrate supplementation: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Med Sci Sports Exerc 2020;52(10):2250-2261. — a FiO₂ não moderou o efeito.

title: A Reta de Londres
subtitle: Laboratório × pódio: o ensaio não achou efeito; o comunicado de 2012 é relato.
content:
[[COMP:LondonSim]]

Fontes

  • Lane SC, Hawley JA, Desbrow B, et al. Single and combined effects of beetroot juice and caffeine supplementation on cycling time trial performance. Appl Physiol Nutr Metab 2014;39(9):1050-1057. — percurso olímpico simulado, 24 ciclistas: cafeína +3,9%, cafeína + beterraba +3,0%, beterraba −0,4%.
  • University of Exeter News. Exeter research reveals winning ingredient that can't be beet. 19/09/2012 (comunicado institucional: relato, não ensaio). — Team GB e atletas de cinco países citados como usuários; David Weir e as quatro medalhas.
  • Jones AM. Dietary nitrate supplementation and exercise performance. Sports Med 2014;44(Suppl 1):S35-S45. — uso em Londres 2012 descrito como relato anedótico.
